findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Set/Prod.lean defines `Set.prod s t = {p | p.1 ∈ s ∧ p.2 ∈ t}`; `Set.Ioc a b = {x | a < x ∧ x ≤ b}`; the stated iff differs from the unfolded form only by these definitional steps.
findings.fix: Prove it by `by simp [elasticLine]` (`Set.mem_prod`, `mem_singleton_iff`, `mem_Ioc` are all simp, and the RHS parses identically), and at line 163 write `(mem_elasticLine.1 hz).1` instead of `hz.1`.
findings.issue: `mem_elasticLine ... := (Iff.rfl)` holds only by unfolding `Set.prod`, `Set.singleton` and `Set.Ioc` simultaneously (`elasticLine S := ({1} : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioc 0 S`), undocumented defeq across three Mathlib definitions. `elasticLine_subset_frontier` (line 163) compounds it: `h.2.1.ne hz.1` typechecks only because `hz.1 : z.1 ∈ ({1} : Set ℝ)` is defeq to `z.1 = 1` rather than going through `mem_elasticLine`.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Tactic/Positivity/Core.lean:459 `res ← orElse res <| compareHyp zα pα e ldecl` — positivity succeeds here only via the unnamed context hypotheses.
findings.fix: Replace both blocks with `obtain ⟨hx, -, hQ, -⟩ := mem_interior_kinematicDomain.1 hz` and use `hx`/`hQ` explicitly (`mul_ne_zero hx.ne' (pow_ne_zero 2 hQ.ne')`, and a one-line comment that `positivity` reads `hx`, `hQ` from the context).
findings.issue: `have := hz.1` / `have := hz.2.2.1` are nameless hypotheses whose only purpose is to be found by `positivity`'s local-hypothesis search; nothing in the proof says why `positivity` can discharge `0 ≤ (z.1 * z.2 ^ 2)⁻¹`, which is false without them. The same `hz.2.2.1`-style projection chain into the four-fold conjunction appears at line 151.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust and well-commented, but `mem_elasticLine` is closed by `Iff.rfl` through three layers of Mathlib definitional unfolding (`×ˢ`, `{1}`, `Ioc`), and that defeq is then consumed at a use site; the Born witness relies on anonymous `have`s existing only for `positivity`'s hypothesis search.
